shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions (US-Iran) spark risk-off behavior with oil rising and pressuring crypto.
Meme coins (SHIB, PEPE) rally while the wider altcoin market retreats.
Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs saw July inflows, but recent BTC outflows offset gains.
Upcoming Fed & BoJ rate decisions next week boost market uncertainty.
Fear & Greed Index drops to 26 ('fear') as rising rates deter crypto investment.
